method.liveAccess: No additional live asset/checkpoint retries; exact original disk cache and verified captured assets only

limitations: Vercel Security Checkpoint prevented further live chunk/media access. Previously captured original HTML/CSS/JS/media and read-only CMS records are replayed without bypassing access controls.
SSR-only references are explicitly identified. They verify server-rendered content/style but do not prove original client interactions or original reveal animations.
Full-page screenshots and heading geometry are evidence, not a claim that every pixel or interaction is identical.
